messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I don’t have a tool that can pull that data directly from an online source, but I can share the standard long‑weekend dates for Canada in 2023 based on public holidays:

| Long Weekend | Dates (2023) | Holiday(s) |
|--------------|--------------|------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1–Jan 3 | New Year’s Day (Jan 1) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20–Feb 22 | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7–Apr 9 | Good Friday (Apr 7) |
| Victoria Day | May 22–May 24 | Victoria Day (May 22) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1–Jul 3 | Canada Day (Jul 1) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4–Sep 6 | Labour Day (Sep 4) |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9–Oct 11 | Thanksgiving (Oct 9) |
| Remembrance Day (if observed) | Nov 11–Nov 13 | Remembrance Day (Nov 11) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25–Dec 27 | Christmas Day (Dec 25) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26–Dec 28 | Boxing Day (Dec 26) |

These are the typical long weekends for most provinces. Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Natal Day in Nova Scotia, etc.) that could create extra long weekends. If you need province‑specific details or confirmation, let me know which provinces you’re interested in, and I can add those dates.
